test_title: PYST 143: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 31 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

PJM : LHM :: NSV : UQK :: JTW : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (3), (2) and (1) is subtracted from the position values according to English alphabetic series from first, second and third letter respectively diagonally.

So,

 
• PJM : LHM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b2ef0472bf92c6078dc4202ad7ae646f6d6da7b2fbf477b05a5a94231441e3c.png] 

And,

 
• NSV : UQK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5742c26e97e11c01a03bfb420793b64ba6d8ea43d3939146dea8686bd8cca05.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• JTW : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcbbb6542122fe6c655194f274564237a902589bce308b7bd1af92a3f8e87721.png] 

​Hence, "**VRG**" is the correct answer.

57
